Ronald Hutton, The Triumph of the Moon: A History of Modern Pagan Witchcraft (Oxford: OUP, 1999)
Origins and history of modern pagan witchcraft; Gardnerian Wicca, the Horned God and Goddess, Romantic Pan revival, ritual structure of the sabbats and circle.
Doreen Valiente, Witchcraft for Tomorrow (London: Robert Hale, 1978)
Insider liturgical handbook of Wiccan practice: the Goddess and Horned God, the Dryghtyn, the Guardians of the Watchtowers, casting the circle, and the eight sabbats of the Wheel of the Year.
